items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

ctx.x: I said, well, alright, now, now we got together. Ori gets together. Ori, get the boys together. If the horse going, oh, the floor is going. Horse, I'll go. Horse going. Ori, we get to the place, listen at this now. Ben Mulligan's had the saloon grabbing in that part. In the back, at a supper. And it was prohibition during that time, but Ben Mulligan, a big politician in the parish prison right around the corner, next block. Ben had liquor there that's like, nah. He had anything he wanted. But only that time, he…

Yeah. So, Ori put, they had a supper, and long table, and waitin', little piggy around there. Nah, they had to sway in. They all got all that mean to the sport. Johnny Topp, and Lewis, and Joe Lindsey. You want to see, I said, listen. I said, I didn't tell them I was going to promise them. My mother. You going? I said, yeah, I'm going. I tell you, stop going. All right. Ori left on a Friday night. They went by the train. I couldn't make it that Friday night to see you all. Ori goes out, comes out to Los Angeles,…
